title: Beyond Feature Fusion: Contextual Bayesian PEFT for Multimodal Uncertainty Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2604.16615v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce CoCo-LoRA, a multimodal, uncertainty-aware parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for text prediction tasks accompanied by audio context. Existing PEFT approaches such as LoRA are efficient but typically deterministic, while recent Bayesian low-rank adapters model uncertainty in a lightweight way yet remain largely unimodal and condition uncertainty primarily on internal text features. This leaves them poorly equipped to reflect uncertainty driven by external acoustic factors such as background noise, channel variability, or speaking style, which can materially affect reliability in speech-centered applications. CoCo-LoRA addresses this gap by conditioning a contextual variational posterior in the low-rank space on both local text-derived adapter features and an audio-derived context signal. A pooled audio embedding is projected once into a shared context space and then adapted through lightweight layer-wise heads,

translated_title: 超越特征融合：面向多模态不确定性估计的上下文贝叶斯参数高效微调
translated_abstract: 我们提出了CoCo-LoRA，这是一种面向伴随音频上下文的文本预测任务的多模态、不确定性感知的参数高效微调方法。现有的PEFT方法（如LoRA）虽然高效但通常是确定性的，而近期的贝叶斯低秩适配器虽能以轻量方式建模不确定性，但基本仍局限于单模态，其不确定性主要依赖于内部文本特征。这使它们难以反映由背景噪声、信道变化或说话风格等外部声学因素所驱动的不确定性，而这些因素会实质性地影响以语音为中心的应用的可靠性。CoCo-LoRA通过将低秩空间中的上下文变分后验同时条件化于局部文本衍生的适配器特征和音频衍生的上下文信号来弥补这一空白。池化后的音频嵌入被一次性投影到共享上下文空间，随后通过轻量级的逐层适配头进行适配。
tldr: CoCo-LoRA提出了一种多模态贝叶斯参数高效微调方法，将音频上下文信号与文本特征共同条件化低秩空间中的变分后验，从而在语音相关任务中实现能够反映背景噪声等外部声学因素的不确定性估计。
en_tdlr: CoCo-LoRA introduces a multimodal Bayesian parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that conditions the low-rank variational posterior on both text-derived features and audio context, enabling uncertainty estimation that reflects external acoustic factors such as background noise and speaking style.
